access: PRIVATE: excluded from reserved solver until freeze.
method: Curriculum designer independently translated all original English prompts before consulting source-editor private models. Bracketed uncertainty notes are editorial checks, not certified lexical selections. Final models must reconcile source evidence and exact register identities before contract acceptance.

items.model: Æt nīehstan se cyning geswāc rīces.
items.explanation: Ceasing is expressed by geswīcan with a genitive of the activity/domain; this is not a perfect auxiliary.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: At length phrase needs visible local support; rīces is the selected genitive government route.

items.model: Hē hæfde ðæt rīce fēowertig gēara.
items.explanation: Ordinary possessed kingdom and a duration expression; hæfde alone does not make a perfect.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Use the locally supplied forty-years phrase if higher numerals remain unassigned.

items.model: Hwonne wǣron ðā brycga geworht?
items.explanation: Plural passive subject and preterite auxiliary; the bare participle remains permitted.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: A correctly inflected predicate is a valid alternative under the prior participle rule.

items.model: Tō-dæg ðū bist mid mē.
items.explanation: Future state with the learned bēo series; accompaniment takes dative.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Eart may be possible with explicit future context; target can select the bēo series.

items.model: Hwæt geworhton ðā Rōmane on Bretene?
items.explanation: Object question and preterite plural build; source requires preterite.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Britain’s exact locative is pending source selection, not yet certified.

items.model: Ic sęnde mīnne engel beforan ðīnum andwlitan.
items.explanation: Accusative sent entity, agreeing possessive, and before with dative.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The larger face expression may be supplied if nominal/idiomatic scope requires it.

items.model: Cum, and bring ðā gewritu ðe gē writon.
items.explanation: Singular commands, relative accusative object and plural second-person past writing.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Singular ðū write is also compatible with unnumbered English you; final editorial control must state selected person consistently.

items.model: Ic gehāte ðē hīernesse, gif ðū mē helpe.
items.explanation: Promise a thing to a dative person; the stated source reference targets dependent subjunctive helpe.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Do not reject a contextually valid indicative generally, but distinguish the explicit196d target.

items.model: Sęnd mē micelne hęre.
items.explanation: Send a thing to a dative recipient; micelne agrees with masculine accusative hęre.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Singular/plural unnumbered command may be accepted consistently.

items.model: Ic feohte wið mīne fīend.
items.explanation: Fight with an opponent is wið plus accusative, not accompaniment mid.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Use selected enemy noun forms with their actual number/gender.

items.model: Ādrīfað ēowre fīend.
items.explanation: Plural command and matching plural addressee’s possessive; enemies are accusative.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Singular Ādrīf ðīne fīend is valid if the unnumbered English is addressed to one person.

items.model: Ðā cęmpan fōron hām.
items.explanation: Simple narrated past; hām is directional home.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Soldier noun’s exact selected spelling is pending source audit.

items.model: Hē cymð mid sciphęre.
items.explanation: Present morphology has prospective reference in context; a fleet accompanies him.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: A genuine intention with willan is valid language but adds a different meaning.

items.model: Slęh ealle ðā ðe ðū gemētst.
items.explanation: Singular command; all the people whom with relative accusative reference.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Final selected slēan command and scope of ealle ðā await audit binding.

items.model: Se hærfest is spēdig on wæstmum.
items.explanation: The adjective governs the selected in-fruits expression; preserve plural fruits.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Pending precise rich adjective and government selection.

items.model: Sǣdtīma and hærfest nǣfre geswīcað.
items.explanation: Plural subject; cease/fail here is intransitive; future meaning comes from context.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The final negative scaffold must preserve the bounded never expression; general negative concord is not assumed.

items.model: Ðæt gēar hæfð fēower tīda.
items.explanation: A possessed seasonal division: have is lexical, not perfect.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Season sense is an explicit additional tīd sense if needed.

items.model: Sēo eorðe is Dryhtnes.
items.explanation: Predicate genitive expresses possession, without an article before the title as Cook directs.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: God’s/Lord’s relation must remain, not a nominative identification.

items.model: Se sǣ geseah, and hē flēah.
items.explanation: Selected masculine sea controls hē; two coordinated preterites.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The personified sea sees without a supplied object; no object is invented.

items.model: Hē flīehð ðæt īserne wǣpen.
items.explanation: Present flēon has future reference and takes the thing avoided as accusative.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Exact iron adjective and weapon quantity are pending lexical audit.

items.model: Se ðe nis hierde and nāh ðā scēap, ðonne hē gesihð ðone wulf, ðonne flīehð hē and forlǣt ðā scēap, and se wulf fēhð ðā scēap.
items.explanation: Keep the complete relative–temporal–main sequence and both sheep objects. The first subject is the nonshepherd; the final wolf is explicit.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Nis and nāh are locally supported contractions unless their full systems are expressly assigned.

items.model: Se dæg is ðīn, sēo niht is ēac ðīn; ðū hæfst ðā sunnan and ðone mōnan gierwed; ðū hæfst ðǣre eorðan gemǣru sętt; ðū hæfst sumer and winter geworht.
items.explanation: Two possessive predicates followed by three transitive completed-action constructions; all clauses retained.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Participle variants must be evidenced and correctly analysed; ordinary simple preterite can be meaningful but does not practise the explicitly selected habban target.

items.model: Gewyrcen wē ðās byrig, and gewyrcen ābūtan him weallas and torras and gatu, ðā-hwīle-ðe ðæt land gīet beforan ūs is.
items.explanation: First-plural exhortation, built objects, about/before datives and a simultaneous temporal clause.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: A parallel coordinated construction with understood wē is valid. Keep exact gīet in source hint; a documented variant is a separate key alternative.

items.model: Ðās ðēoda sindon mā ðonne ic; hū mæg ic hīe ādrīfan?
items.explanation: Quantitative comparison and ability plus infinitive; object refers to the nations.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The precise bounded more-than phrase requires explicit teaching or visible help, not an unassigned general quantity system.

items.model: Gā tō sǣ, and weorp fiscangul, and nim ðone ǣrestan fisc, and geopena his mūð.
items.explanation: Singular commands form a connected set; first fish has article plus weak adjective; mouth has invariant his.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Exact hook headword is pending source audit; the directions are to the same singular person as thou in20.9.

items.model: Ðū gemētst pęning; nim ðone, and sęle for mē and for ðē.
items.explanation: Present with future reference followed by singular commands; ðone points to masculine penny.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: For-benefit phrase is bounded and must be supplied/explicitly taught; no unannounced payment idiom.

items.model: Ðā cwæð hē: “Hēo nis dēad.”
items.explanation: Past saying introduces a direct present-state assertion.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Nis remains available in local support if the negative copula is not productive.

items.model: Ðā nōm hē hiere hand, and cwæð: “Fǣmne, rīs.”
items.explanation: Past take/say, invariant feminine possessor, singular direct command.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: A separately supported ārīs is a valid lexical alternative; selected unprefixed rīs avoids inventing a new prefixed paradigm.

items.model: Se stǣnena weall is seofon fōta brād and twēntig fōta hēah.
items.explanation: Article plus weak stone adjective; genitive measure with both dimensions.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The twenty phrase may remain supplied while foot has a complete productive paradigm; no whole higher numeral system follows.

items.model: Ic grētte hīe, and cȳðde hiere ðæt ic nǣfre mā hīe genēosian wolde.
items.explanation: Leave-taking takes accusative person; announcement takes dative person and reported content; visit remains prospective from the reported refusal.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Genēosian plain infinitive requires an explicit new assignment. Bounded nǣfre mā support must stay visible.

items.model: Ðā rihtwīsan sindon swā bealde swā lēo.
items.explanation: Articled weak personal adjective subject; predicate bold agrees with plural people; lion is the comparison standard without an indefinite article.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: A different defensible comparative realization can be accepted if it preserves as bold as and the selected lexical sense.

items.model: Ðā Bryttas wǣron earge.
items.explanation: Plural people and plural predicate adjective; simple past.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Reference is the Britons, not the Romans.

items.model: Cum hider, fægere fǣmne.
items.explanation: Singular command with directional hither; the address has a weak feminine adjective.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: No extra O is required by the English. A documented maiden synonym is valid only if actually taught or supplied.

items.model: Ēadig is ðæt folc ðæs God is Dryhten.
items.explanation: Neuter singular people, adjective predicate, and genitive relative whose inside the dependent clause.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: An explicitly inflected-relative-plus-ðe variant can also be grammatical. No new indefinite article is required.

items.model: Leorniað æt mē, for-ðon-ðe ic eom mildheort and ēaðmōd on heortan, and gē gemētað ręste ēowrum sāwlum.
items.explanation: Plural command, learning source with æt, causal clause, heart respect phrase and dative beneficiary souls.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The final model must use only the specifically taught source/benefit frames; no broad preposition substitution is inferred.

items.model: Nū sęnde ic ēow swā scēap gemang wulfum.
items.explanation: Plural sent people, as-sheep comparison and among plus dative wolves.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: As describes their role/situation, not the subject’s identity.

items.model: Ðonne hīe ēhtað ēow on ðisse byrig, flēoð on ōðre.
items.explanation: Pursue has the attested accusative-person frame; stationary in this city is dative, motion into another uses accusative with understood city.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: The separately evidenced genitive ēower can be a valid lexical alternative, but it is not the sole route. Keep the elliptical city scaffold visible.

items.model: Ic grēte mīnne ēðel.
items.explanation: Leave-taking takes native land as an accusative object.
items.scope_or_uncertainty: Selected native-country headword and its quantity await final source audit.
